rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb used before the name of the transport, as in 上車, 上船, or 上機.

example.english: We can board the boat now.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 soeng5 syun4 laa1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a physical wooden plank or board.

example.english: This board is too long to fit in the cabinet.
example.traditional: 呢塊木板太長，放唔入個櫃。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 muk6 baan2 taai3 coeng4 fong3 m4 jap6 go3 gwai6

rows.note: Use this for a committee that governs or manages an organization; a specifically directors’ board is more often 董事會.

example.english: The board is meeting today to discuss the new plan.
example.traditional: 公司嘅委員會今日開會討論新計劃。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 ge3 wai2 jyun4 wui6 gam1 jat6 hoi1 wui6 tou2 leon6 san1 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this for the marked playing surface of a board game.

example.english: Put the piece in the middle of the board.
example.traditional: 你將隻棋放喺棋盤中間。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoeng1 zek3 kei4 fong3 hai2 kei4 pun4 zung1 gaan1

rows.note: Use this for the meals provided as part of lodging or accommodation, often in 伙食費.

example.english: The board fee at this hostel includes breakfast.
example.traditional: 呢間旅館嘅伙食費包埋早餐。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 leoi5 gun2 ge3 fo2 sik6 fai3 baau1 maai4 zou2 caan1
